company.name: Flockjay
company.shortDescription: Flockjay is an online academy that empowers job seekers with the tools and training they need to break into tech.
company.description: Flockjay connects startups with sales professionals and educates job seekers through remote learning. Flockjay provides training and support for in-demand tech jobs and provides final round interviews for high-paying jobs at top companies. The company's mission is to make tech accessible for people from underrepresented communities.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $11,000,000, or 77.85% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,400,969 to $67,739,833, a 19.92x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
